name: Benjamin Netanyahu
role: Prime Minister of Israel (2022–present); May 12, 2026: CBS 60 Minutes first partial accountability concession — 'everybody bears some responsibility, from the prime minister down' — without committing to a specific investigation mechanism
quote: Everybody bears some responsibility, from the prime minister down. But what about everything since October 7? [CBS 60 Minutes, ~May 10-11, 2026 — analyzed by Jerusalem Post May 12 as first explicit partial self-inclusion in culpability, while deflecting to collective responsibility and blocking the independent commission 74% of Israelis demand.]

name: Yoav Gallant
role: Israeli Defense Minister (2022–Nov 2024)
quote: We are fighting human animals and we will act accordingly. Gaza will not return to what it was before October 7.

name: Lt. Gen. Herzi Halevi
role: IDF Chief of Staff (until Jan 2025)
quote: The IDF failed in its most basic mission — to protect the citizens of Israel. I take full responsibility.

name: Ronen Bar
role: Shin Bet Director (until Mar 2025)
quote: The Shin Bet failed in its mission. I bear responsibility for the intelligence failure that allowed October 7 to occur.

name: Benny Gantz
role: National Unity/Opposition Leader; War Cabinet Member (resigned Jun 2024)
quote: Netanyahu is holding up a deal. If the government does not present a clear post-war plan, we will leave the war cabinet.

name: Yahya Sinwar
role: Hamas Leader in Gaza; October 7 Mastermind (killed Oct 16, 2024)
quote: We are the ones who started this war and we know how to end it. Every martyr, every wounded person will open a gate to liberation.

name: Ismail Haniyeh
role: Hamas Political Bureau Chairman (assassinated Jul 31, 2024)
quote: The Al-Aqsa Flood has overturned the equations of the region. Palestine has returned to the center of the world's attention.

name: Mohammed Deif
role: Hamas Military Commander — announced Operation Al-Aqsa Flood
quote: Today, the era of this enemy's rampaging without accountability has ended. Launch thousands of rockets in the first hour.

name: Joe Biden
role: US President (2021–Jan 2025)
quote: The terrorist group Hamas unleashed pure, unadulterated evil. We stand with Israel. Israel has the right to defend itself.

name: Antony Blinken
role: US Secretary of State (2021–Jan 2025)
quote: I come to Israel as an American — but also as a Jew. The United States will always be there for Israel.

name: Donald Trump
role: US President (Jan 2025–present); brokered 20-point Gaza peace plan
quote: We got all the hostages home. Now we need to finish building the peace — a real peace, not the fake peace everyone else tried.

name: António Guterres
role: UN Secretary-General
quote: The attacks by Hamas did not happen in a vacuum. But nothing can justify the deliberate targeting and killing of civilians. International humanitarian law must be respected by all parties.

name: Karim Khan
role: ICC Prosecutor
quote: The law is not a barrier to military action, it is a framework for that action. Arrest warrants have been issued for Netanyahu, Gallant, and Hamas commanders.

name: Pramila Patten
role: UN Special Representative on Sexual Violence in Conflict
quote: There are reasonable grounds to believe that sexual violence including rape and gang rape occurred in multiple locations on October 7 and continues against hostages.

name: Cyril Ramaphosa
role: South African President — filed ICJ genocide case
quote: South Africa has approached the ICJ because the scale of Israel's actions in Gaza constitutes genocide. We have an obligation under international law to act.

name: Itamar Ben Gvir
role: Israeli National Security Minister; Far-Right Coalition Partner. May 23, 2026: Banned from France (and Poland) over 'unspeakable' flotilla activist taunting video — Netanyahu said conduct 'not in line with Israel's values' but kept him in cabinet
quote: These are terrorists helping murderers. I ordered the October 7 horror video screened to them. Anyone who tries to break our blockade supporting Hamas will see exactly what Hamas did.

name: Bezalel Smotrich
role: Israeli Finance Minister; Far-Right Coalition Partner
quote: The State of Israel will not allow a Palestinian state. The correct solution is voluntary emigration of the Arab population from Gaza.

name: Yair Lapid
role: Israeli Opposition Leader (Yesh Atid)
quote: Netanyahu had the intelligence, had the warnings, and chose not to act. The hostages are rotting in tunnels while he plays politics.

name: Emmanuel Macron
role: French President
quote: France stands with Israel in the face of terrorism. But civilians in Gaza must be protected. The images coming from Gaza are unbearable.

name: Yocheved Lifshitz
role: Israeli Hostage — Released Nov 2023 (age 85, Kibbutz Nir Oz)
quote: They took very good care of us. They brought us medicines, but what they did before taking us was very difficult.

name: Nickolay Mladenov
role: UN High Representative for Gaza (Board of Peace, 2026)
quote: We continue to engage Hamas in Cairo and Ankara. The deadline has passed but the door for agreement remains open — the cost of failure is resumed war and further suffering for Palestinians.

name: Khaled Meshaal
role: Hamas Political Bureau Chairman (2026)
quote: We submitted serious amendments to the disarmament proposal. Disarming an occupied people without a guaranteed end to occupation and a political horizon is a trap, not peace.

name: Khalil al-Hayya
role: Hamas Gaza Chief; led Hamas delegation in April 2026 Cairo Phase 2 talks; fourth son Azzam killed by IDF strike, May 7, 2026
quote: We are waiting for Mladenov to provide a clear timetable for Israel to fulfill the remaining obligations of Phase One. We will not discuss disarmament while Israel violates the ceasefire daily.

name: Aryeh Lightstone
role: US Senior Adviser; led US delegation in April 17, 2026 Cairo Phase 2 talks
quote: We expect Hamas to soon enter the disarmament process. The reconstruction of Gaza and the future of the Palestinian people depend on it.

name: Maj. Gen. Tomer Bar
role: Outgoing Israeli Air Force Commander (until May 5, 2026); called for independent Oct 7 inquiry at handover
quote: An independent investigation is vital for the IDF, for all security bodies, for the families who paid the highest price, for trust between citizens and the military, and for the state.

name: Maj. Gen. Omer Tishler
role: Israeli Air Force Commander (from May 5, 2026) — succeeded Maj. Gen. Tomer Bar; immediately integrated into Gaza war resumption planning
quote: I inherit command at a critical hour. The air force will continue to operate against all threats with precision, determination, and full capability.

name: Naftali Bennett
role: Former PM of Israel (2021–2022); formed unified electoral alliance with Lapid (announced May 11, 2026); pledged independent Oct. 7 state commission as Day 1 governing priority
quote: On Day 1 of our government, we will establish a fully independent state commission of inquiry into October 7. The families of 1,195 victims have waited 947 days. They will not wait any longer. Restoring citizens' trust in the security establishment begins with accountability.

name: Dr. Cochav Elkayam-Levy
role: Chair, Civil Commission on October 7th Crimes by Hamas; published final two-year investigation May 12, 2026, documenting systematic sexual violence including abuse of minors
quote: The sexual violence on October 7 was systematic, widespread, and integral to the attack — a calculated strategy, not spontaneous acts. Every case in our final report is cross-referenced with independent witness accounts. This documentation is essential for justice and for history.

name: MK Ariel Kallner
role: Likud MK; sponsor of coalition's October 7 inquiry bill; on May 13, 2026, a Knesset committee revealed Kallner had quietly removed 'full, thorough, and independent investigation' from the bill's purpose clause, prompting opposition accusations of cover-up
quote: The change was made only for conciseness. The committee's mandate remains as robust as before. [May 13, 2026 Knesset committee — disputed by legal advisers, opposition, and bereaved family organizations who called the bill a 'political whitewash.']

name: Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir
role: IDF Chief of Staff (from Jan 2025); on May 16, 2026 confirmed killing of Izz al-Din al-Haddad, calling it 'a significant operational achievement'
quote: The name of the master murderer, Iz al-Din Haddad, came up time and time again in conversations with returned hostages. Today, we succeeded in eliminating him. [May 16, 2026 — on the IDF precision strike killing al-Haddad, head of Hamas military wing and last October 7 architect in Gaza]

name: Izz al-Din al-Haddad
role: Head of Hamas Military Wing in Gaza; member of Hamas Military Council; one of the last senior architects of the October 7 attack; captor of Nahal Oz surveillance soldiers Liri Albag, Daniela Gilboa, Karina Ariev, Naama Levy, Agam Berger; KILLED in IDF airstrike, Gaza City Rimal, May 15–16, 2026 (Day 952)
quote: I was involved in the October 7 operation. [Al Jazeera interview, citing IDF; al-Haddad acknowledged his role in October 7 planning. He joined Hamas at its founding in the late 1980s and rose to lead the military wing after Mohammed Sinwar's death, working to rebuild Hamas's military capabilities before being killed in a precision IDF strike in Gaza City, May 15–16, 2026.]

name: Mohammed Odeh
role: Hamas Al-Qassam Brigades Commander in Gaza (from May 18, 2026); former Hamas military intelligence chief; served on Supreme Military Council during October 7 planning; appointed to succeed killed al-Haddad
quote: Hamas will continue its resistance. The occupation cannot eliminate our will to resist through assassinations. [Paraphrased from Hamas organizational communications; Odeh has not made direct public statements since his appointment.]
